title: Auditable Belief Updates as a Missing Safety Layer for LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.38869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as cognitive interfaces that shape how users interpret evidence, communicate, and make decisions. As deployed systems become more multimodal, tool-using, and multi-agent, safety failures no longer arise only from isolated harmful outputs, but also from how agents update, store, and propagate epistemic commitments across retrieval, memory, tools, and peer communication. In this paper, we define belief as an engineering abstraction for evidence-based commitments that guide downstream action. Building on this view, we propose the Explicit Belief Multi-Agent System (EB-MAS), which externalizes belief states into a structured substrate, uses belief operators to propose candidate updates, and applies a Cognitive Firewall to bound or reject updates that are weakly evidenced but strongly driven by vulnerability cues. translated_title: 可审计的信念更新：LLM驱动的多智能体系统中缺失的安全层
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作认知接口，塑造着用户解读证据、进行沟通和做出决策的方式。随着部署系统变得更加多模态、更多使用工具并呈现多智能体形态，安全故障不再仅源于孤立的有害输出，还源于智能体如何在检索、记忆、工具调用和同伴通信过程中更新、存储和传播认知承诺。本文将“信念”定义为一个工程抽象，用于表示指导下游行动的基于证据的承诺。基于这一视角，我们提出了显式信念多智能体系统（EB-MAS），该系统将信念状态外化到结构化底座中，使用信念算子提出候选更新，并应用“认知防火墙”来限制或拒绝那些证据薄弱却受脆弱性线索强烈驱动的更新。我们还讨论了群体层面的群体信念风险，包括……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出显式信念多智能体系统（EB-MAS），通过将信念状态外化为结构化底座、用信念算子生成候选更新，并借助认知防火墙拦截证据薄弱却受脆弱性线索驱动的更新，为LLM驱动的多智能体系统补上了可审计的信念更新这一缺失的安全层。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Explicit Belief Multi-Agent System (EB-MAS), which externalizes belief states into a structured substrate, uses belief operators to propose candidate updates, and applies a Cognitive Firewall to bound or reject weakly-evidenced updates driven by vulnerability cues, thereby adding auditable belief updates as a missing safety layer for LLM-powered multi-agent systems.
